normative_branches.result: No general activity original is uploaded on any network.

normative_branches.result: Upload is permitted only on Wi-Fi; cellular is QUEUED_UNTIL_WIFI.

current_implementation: Motion state is UNKNOWN, WALKING or STATIONARY; stationary confirmation is 5,000 ms in the current default controller.
UNKNOWN fails closed, WALKING blocks, Wi-Fi allows, approved cellular allows, non-opted cellular queues until Wi-Fi, OFFLINE/OTHER fails closed.
Movement or loss of admissible state increments a generation and cancels queued/active debug upload work.
The upload rule is scoped to original-activity upload and does not disable general authentication or navigation network traffic.
runtime_flows.implementation_gap: No persistent encrypted 30-day queue, chunk resume, receipt-bound deletion or whole original-activity pipeline is proven by the bound code. Branch 4 is therefore normative but not implementation-complete.
